findings.value: Mainly a heritage museum with a monthly Sunday Victorian classroom lesson, school-holiday family activities and exhibitions. Its music event is a festival held each June.

evidence.quote: On the first Sunday of every month, we invite you to step through our doors
Fifth Ragged School Music Festival: Schubertiade
This June, the Ragged Music Festival returns with a very different kind of edition.

not_found: types: no quote calls it a music, theatre, gallery or community venue in its own words (it describes itself as a museum, which is not on the types list)
music.styles: the music festival names no genre repeatedly; one 2025 edition was titled Schubertiade and a chamber choir concert is listed without a usable date
cost.notes: no general pricing stated; the Victorian lessons and family activities are described without prices on the pages read
upcoming music nights: none listed for 2026 on the news page
notes: Nights found: First Sunday Victorian Lesson, monthly, two lessons at 11:30am and 12:45pm, 45 minutes each, led by an actor in Victorian costume (venue's page, undated); Summer holiday family activities (Thursdays in July 2026, news page); Half term family activities (Wednesday 18 and Thursday 19 February 2026, news page); Pattern Cutters exhibition (7 June to 6 July 2025); Fifth Ragged Music Festival: Schubertiade (20 to 22 June 2025). The annual music festival is the music scout's; only its place here is recorded.
